posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina and Vicky Kaushal introduced their son Vihaan to paparazzi at Mumbai airport, requesting privacy and no photos of her carrying the baby.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Made history as the first South Asian artist to sell out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden on his AURA tour. His new Imtiaz Ali film with AR Rahman drops June 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Her YRF Spy Universe action film 'Alpha' with Sharvari and Bobby Deol is gearing up for a July 10 release. Co-star Bobby praised her all-in commitment to intense action scenes.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Filming SS Rajamouli's epic 'GlobeTrotter' alongside Mahesh Babu, with six months of shooting still remaining for the ambitious April 2027 release.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Filming 'King' in South Africa with daughter Suhana and Deepika Padukone — the action thriller with a massive ₹350 crore budget is locked for Christmas 2026.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Set to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's superhero film, while sharing stylish family moments and Pataudi weekend getaways on social media.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Currently filming 'Naagin' directed by Laxman Utekar and signed a ₹17 crore deal for a thriller with Ekta Kapoor, riding high after the mega-hit Stree 2.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Juggling multiple blockbusters — Shah Rukh Khan's 'King', Prabhas' 'Spirit' with Sandeep Reddy Vanga, and Allu Arjun-Atlee's massive sci-fi AA22xA6.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Facing FWICE non-cooperation directive over his Don 3 exit amid ₹45 crore dispute. Visited Mysuru's Chamundeshwari Temple after a Karnataka High Court directive.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Dazzled at Cannes 2026 in a custom Luminara gown with 1500+ crystals, urging young actors to embrace authenticity over manufactured trends at the festival.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: 'Cocktail 2' romantic track 'Tujhko' with Shahid Kapoor is creating buzz. Also filming Allu Arjun's AA22xA6 and reuniting with Vijay Deverakonda for period drama 'Rana Baali'.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Making her acting comeback with 'Maa Inti Bangaram' releasing June 19 — a fierce action thriller where she plays a traditional woman hiding a warrior past.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: His sci-fi spectacle AA22xA6 with director Atlee is in production — a VFX-heavy parallel universe narrative with a massive ₹600 crore budget targeting 2027.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: 'Peddi' is generating massive buzz with 100M+ trailer views and $393K in North American pre-sales ahead of its June 4 release. Chiranjeevi helped resolve theatre disputes.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Paid emotional tribute to his grandfather NTR Rama Rao on his 103rd birth anniversary at NTR Ghat in Hyderabad. His film 'Dragon' with Prashanth Neel is locked for release.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Promoting 'Peddi' alongside Ram Charan ahead of its June 4 release, while her film 'Homebound' was selected as India's official entry for the 2026 Oscars.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: 'Chand Mera Dil' crossed ₹26 crore globally in its first week, though her Bharatanatyam fusion dance sequence sparked debate among classical dancers.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Set to portray legendary actress Madhubala in a Sanjay Leela Bhansali biopic, while sharing heartfelt parenting insights after her daughter's birth.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Wrapping up War 2 with a final epic dance face-off with Jr NTR at Yash Raj Studios, while Krrish 4 faces delays over a VFX partnership disagreement with YRF.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Promoting 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' releasing June 5 — a family-friendly romantic comedy directed by his father David Dhawan, reuniting with Maniesh Paul.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Wrapped her 'All Hearts Tour' with a grand Mumbai finale and announced a UK and US concert tour for 2026, including shows at The O2 and Texas Trust CU Theatre.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: On a 40-day digital detox to compose the soundtrack for Nitesh Tiwari's epic 'Ramayana' starring Ranbir Kapoor, set for Diwali 2026 release.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: His final film 'Jananayagan' eyes a blockbuster June 25 release to coincide with his birthday, positioned as a potential record-breaking farewell to cinema.
